lines.say: Three days inside a giant fish? This really is one of the strangest stories in the Bible!
God told Jonah to go to the big city of Nineveh, and warn the people.
But Jonah didn't want to go. So he ran the other way, all the way to the harbor.
He jumped on a ship sailing far away, hoping to hide.
Then a huge storm hit. Giant waves crashed over the ship!
The sailors were terrified. Jonah knew the storm was because of him.
So he told them: throw me into the sea. And splash, in he went!
Then a giant fish opened its mouth, and swallowed Jonah whole!
For three days and three nights, Jonah sat inside the fish, and prayed.
Then the fish spat him out, right onto the beach!
This time, Jonah walked all the way to Nineveh.
And the people listened and changed their ways. Would you have run away too? Tell me in the comments!
